name: ai-token-budget-card
title: S31 AI 上下文预算小卡 (AiTokenBudgetCard)
description: AI 上下文预算小卡（S31 · 尺寸 S）— Token 环形用量 · 缓存命中 · 费用

files.content:
import { Sparkle } from '@phosphor-icons/react' import { AiContextMeter, type AiContextUsage } from '@/components/ui/ai-context-meter' import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress' import { Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile' import { TILE_THEMES, type Hue, type TileTone } from '@/lib/tokens' export interface AiTokenBudgetCardProps { label?: string usage: AiContextUsage cacheHitRate?: string hue?: Hue tone?: TileTone } export function AiTokenBudgetCard({ label = '上下文窗口', usage, cacheHitRate = '64%', hue = 'periwinkle', tone = 'white', }: AiTokenBudgetCardProps) { const theme = TILE_THEMES[tone] const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((usage.usedTokens / Math.max(1, usage.maxTokens)) * 100)) return (
{label}
{(usage.usedTokens / 1000).toFixed(1)}k / {Math.round(usage.maxTokens / 1000)}k
缓存命中 {cacheHitRate} · {usage.estimatedCost ?? '$0.18'}
) }
